control_result.numeric_pid_timeout_error: 'float' object cannot be interpreted as an integer

findings: show_results aliases original sample lists into lines_normalized then overwrites elements with -1. Reporting mutates stored measurements; reproduced with exact function, two lines and unequal repeat counts.
memory_usage numeric PID timeout computes timeout/interval then passes float to range on Python3. Reproduced TypeError before any sample.

Callable branch runs target in a child process by default or worker thread in run_in_place mode, not same-thread caller execution. Return value and child exception are not propagated; join after sampling has no timeout. Static finding; no target launched.
trace_memory_usage retains every line-event sample in lists with no sample cap; unlike newer0.31 maxima-only storage this creates observer growth proportional to events. No growth benchmark.
magic_memit parses repeat but calls memory_usage once and only interpolates repeat in printed label. Static finding; no IPython magic executed.
LineProfiler.disable clears tracing with sys.settrace(None), not previous handler restoration. No hooks changed in control.

psutil path requires deprecated get_memory_info only; access denied becomes -1 and can enter reports. Fallback samples RSS divided by1024, psutil uses2**20, despite docstring claiming KB. Static finding.
CLI uses caller/global namespaces and injected builtins.profile with no restoration; magic still uses Python2 StringIO/__builtin__. Full import/runtime compatibility not qualified.
